closure_unit.outcome: The 44,066-line app.rs becomes small toolkit-free crates for session, navigation, document lifecycle, settings, layout, background work and motion, consumed by the frozen egui host and by the new shell.

materialized_acceptance.text: Closure: each extracted crate compiles without egui, eframe, egui-winit, egui-wgpu, egui_tiles, epaint, ecolor, emath, egui_kittest, kumihimo-egui, cabinet-egui, cabinet-peak-egui, handshake_context_menu_egui, wgpu, wgpu-core, wgpu-hal, glow and exposes no toolkit type; the app state, navigation, document lifecycle, settings, layout, background work and motion crates are separate.

Baseline and progress: app.rs starts at 44,066 lines (134 top-level items, 751 methods in impl HandshakeApp, lines 8227 to 42392). Every slice reports lines moved and the crate line counts; a slice that moves nothing is not progress.
Final state: app.rs holds only the egui host's composition and adapters; no domain state, no workflow state machine, no transport; the new shell consumes the same crates.
Behaviour is unchanged: existing host tests keep their executed count; app.rs inline test modules (from line 40006) move with their subject.
Completions (the Mt0xx operation structs at lines 124 to 4116 and the Pending* structs) become named state machines per feature with their own crate or module, not one shared enum.
Settings, layout and session persistence read and write the same bytes as today; old and new hosts can open each other's state.
The frame loop has no hidden work: each crate exposes an explicit update(now, inputs) -> effects and a wake or damage reason; nothing polls per frame without a reason.

Motion crate: monotonic clock injected by the host, MT-200 duration table, interruptible sampling toward an already committed destination, one preference (normal or reduced) shared by both hosts; no decorative motion delays an action.
HBR-COMPART-002: warm rebuild time and relinked test binaries are measured before the first slice and after the last and recorded.
No new aggregate: a crate that only re-exports or that other crates must all depend on is rejected in review.

implementation_steps.step: S1 (first coding slice): motion crate. Injected monotonic clock, duration table type, interruptible value toward a committed destination, normal/reduced preference; pure tests for start, interrupt, reversal, reduced and duplicate input. No host file touched.
S2: layout_state crate over layout_snapshot: load, save, reconcile and reset as a state machine (app.rs 5890 and layout worker 4598).
S3: navigation crate: view mode, module switch, tab open and close targets, pending navigation operations (app.rs 4561, 4758, 3834-3870).
S4: document_lifecycle crate: open, load failure, save, conflict, code-save transaction (app.rs 4718-5040 and the Win32CodeSaveApi seam).
S5: operations: move each completion struct family into its own module or crate with its tests.
S6: settings_state and background_work: debounce, re-probe, workers as explicit update -> effects.
S7: shrink app.rs to composition; report final line counts and the HBR-COMPART-002 measurement.

hbr_obligations.obligation_or_reason: Surface mounts only in the kernel-owned Vulkan shell; no toolkit type in a public contract; asset-local hosts are not acceptance.
Each control and action declared once with a stable id that feeds GUI, AccessKit, Argus and UserManual.
No GPU work.
Every cache, queue and buffer bounded and accounted, with overload, cancel, stale-revision and release behaviour.
GUI actions, states, errors and GPU failures through the existing internal_diagnostics allowlist, content-free.
Survival is proven with the composed shell in MT-202.
Every command carries actor/session, command id, revision and correlation; correlation grants nothing.
State for docking, settings and focus; presentation belongs to MT-200.
Egui host behaviour after each move, plus the new shell after MT-213.
Renderer error scan on every captured frame: Vulkan validation messages and runtime errors; any error fails.
Capture matrix: normal, constrained viewport, and empty/error/loading/multi-item states.
Trace projection where there is no direct surface.
A surface Argus cannot see or steer is repaired in this MT or recorded as a blocking gap.
Automated runs use a quiet, never-activated window or offscreen frame; zero focus or Z-order change.
No OS input injection, cursor movement or foregrounding on any path, tests included.
Background launches record owner and are reclaimed; no orphan windows or processes.
A step that needs the foreground (real OS IME typing) is declared first and run by the Operator.
Three-tier diagnostic outcome recorded per tier (hbr_int_009_tier_obligations).
One owning module in execution.module_ref; write scope derives from its roots; dependency direction stated.
Warm rebuild time and relinked test binaries recorded for the candidate.
Mechanic consumed from its single existing owner (context_capsule.consumed_capability_refs).
No new canonical mechanic without a spec primitive and an owner search.
Accountable owner and independently selectable source, dependency, build, test and artifact closure.
Exact embedding adapter; host policy stays in Handshake.
Asset change lands in its canonical repository and is re-read before any host write.
Missing shared logic is added to the asset first; no host workaround, copy or fork.
Scope linkage preserved on every projected resource.
Default deny kept for missing, stale or revoked context at every boundary touched.
Concurrent accounts see neither content nor existence metadata of each other.
Logout, switch or revocation clears or fences caches, captures, snapshots and stale UI state.
Concurrent agents plus Operator edits: no silent last-writer-wins; conflicts are typed.
Cargo target under the one artifact root, owner-scoped, named in the dispatch (KB-OUT-008).
Owner cleans only its own scoped artifact folder.
UserManual updated in the same change; MANUAL_VERSION bumped where declared.
A no-context model can operate the surface from the manual alone.
Manual entries are code-truthful and self-consistency tested.
